note.text: Architecture checkpoint on main@68c38b4: all ten 2.0.1 findings remain valid. Recommended additive 2.1.0 design: SQLx-free strict delivery contract/types in eventcore-types; transactional async PostgreSQL projector/runner in eventcore-postgres; existing APIs retained. DeliveryPosition is positive BIGINT allocated through a transactionally locked singleton frontier and immutable mapping table; same read-model session owns advisory leadership and every apply+checkpoint transaction. Mixed source/destination DBs explicit. Decode failures terminal; batch drains; reset uses same lock and atomic clear+progress reset; after-commit only after confirmed commit. Migration requires coordinated reset/replay; no shadow generations. Awaiting user approval before ADRs/tests/implementation.
